it is certain that the auspicious path of worship will be abandoned by those common people who act upon your strength and dominion.

by the common people. Therefore, there is a need for heroes with ideal character in society. Krishna, that is, the complete Supreme Personality of Godhead, appeared in this world to present the example of complete authority.
And people have to follow the same path. ©. It is a Vedic command that man
cannot understand the Supreme Brahman only through mental contemplation or reasoning. He has to follow the great men.
It happens. The path is known to the great men. Great men should be followed--otherwise, if we
remain dependent only on branches, then sometimes we may be misled by cunning people, or we
cannot understand various spiritual orders, or we cannot follow them. The best way
is to follow great men. All four Brahmin sages said that Krishna, by nature,
protects cows and Brahmins §— for the benefit of cows and Brahmins.
